propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches the requested name against the transition's own name, but callers pass destination status names, causing lookup failure on workflows where transition names differ from status names
the transport raises ValueError on name mismatch, which is caught as a soft failure, allowing the pass to exit 0 without applying the status change
some status changes succeed by accident when transition name and destination status name coincide (e.g., 'Done'), creating the appearance of partial or flaky sync
the function should resolve against both transition name (exact match preferred) and destination status name (to.name field) to handle mismatched workflows correctly
an ambiguous destination with multiple transitions declaring the same to.name should raise an error naming the ambiguity rather than picking one silently
the error message must list available transition names and their destination statuses so users can diagnose mapping defects
